defaultLookbackGuidance: Ask developer what range to cover before generating.
promptContext: Focus on reusable Paper plugin engine behavior, commands, scheduler, GUI, config handling, packaging, library consumers, docs, and contributor-facing changes.
sectionGuidance: After summary, organize changelog details into labeled areas such as Fixed, Added, Changed, Removed, Security, Docs, Internal, or other clear headings when applicable.

The Moonrise publish payload uses `body: string` (full markdown). Write the body using standard markdown: `## Fixed`, `## Added`, `## Changed`, etc. as section headings, with `- item` bullets under each.
Keep each section heading followed by item entries that repeat the same area keyword, for example 'Fixed: ...'. Optional spacer entries like ' ' are allowed between sections when useful.
